Ontario open data for OpenStreetMap

Datasets · Portals · Summary · Wiki view · CSVs

Every open data source we know of that could feed OSM in Ontario: what it is good for, and how much of it is already in OSM. 30947 sources (22691 not usable, 4355 no licence, 3843 available, 26 parked, 15 onboarding, 13 ongoing, 3 completed, 1 planned); 125 measures. Generated 2026-10-16.

Value is what OSM would gain (how it is graded): A a large gap filled B features OSM lacks in bulk C a gaps list or reference D small, or OSM has it F not something OSM maps. The page opens on the 2,514 rows graded A to C or not graded; D and F load when you pick them. Grades are a first pass and unreviewed.

A row here is not permission to import. Licence verdicts live on Canada#Open Data and the OSMF OGL Canada and local variants page.
